summary: Amends a specific plan (SP) and rezones 7435 Old Hickory Boulevard, about 632 feet west of Blevins Road (34.74 acres), from AR2a to SP. It allows a mixed use development with up to 208,000 square feet of non-residential uses such as office, retail, light manufacturing and warehouse, and bans short term rentals. It also sets conditions, including no outdoor storage.
